chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
A self-respecting man never commits adultery.
ai.seo_question: What does Ghayrah mean in preventing adultery?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) asserts that a person endowed with 'ghayrah' (vigilant self-respect) is inherently protected from adultery, linking moral integrity to spiritual vigilance. This concept is central to Shia ethics, where 'ghayrah' is viewed not merely as jealousy but as a divine quality that guards one's honor and prevents major sins through internal accountability.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 305. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
A self respecting man never commits adultery.
